name: Sagar Samman Award- Sagar Samman Varuna Award
benefit: - Statue of Lord Varuna - Citation Certificate - National-level recognition and prestige
_eligibility_text: 1. The applicant should be an Indian citizen, Person of Indian Origin (PIO), or Overseas Citizen of India (OCI). 1. The applicant should have at least 5 years of outstanding contributions. 1. The applicant should have contributed significantly in at least 2 major maritime areas. 1. The applicant should demonstrate leadership, innovation, and institutional impact. 1. The applicant should have impeccable integrity and reputation. 1. The applicant should be nominated by at least 2 entities or peers; self-nomination requires 2 recommendations. 1. The applicant should not have any reputational or ethical issues. 1. Government serving officers are not eligible.
